PM Modi to inaugurate 5 Ladakh projects worth ₹3,350 crore

Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate five major infrastructure and development projects in Ladakh on Thursday. The projects are collectively valued at ₹3,350 crore and span areas from airports and parks to roads.
